title: FBI briefing to Congress and ongoing FBI investigation of legacy program

tellings.quote: Cuz I'm told that the briefing that the FBI gave in Congress really blew people away. And watch that FBI ongoing investigation. I've dealt with some of the people on the investigation team.

plain: In 2025 the FBI is said to have briefed Congress on a secret older UFO effort, and the briefing reportedly "really blew people away." The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels he heard this from others, and says the FBI's investigation is still going on and that he has dealt with some of the people on its team. If true, it would mean a federal law enforcement agency is looking into a hidden programme.
